title: Overdue Build Thread - Fj60 5.3 swap
ai_summary: FJ60 Land Cruiser rebuilt around a 5.3L GM LS-family V8 swap (started late 2014) as part of a full restoration including a strip-down, TRD Pro Cement color change, and full interior redo. The specific LS variant, transmission, and performance figures were not detailed in the visible posts, but the builder fabricated custom engine-management and steering hardware.

complications.detail: Fabricated a custom ECU shelf from 16-gauge stainless steel mounted to the driver's inner fender
Fabricated a high-pressure power steering coupler to mate the GM power steering pump to the Toyota steering gearbox
